description: What is enforced versus convention for token usage in PageSpecs. Category names are exactly the keys of token-catalog.json categories.

color.use: a semantic colour id from the catalog; section backgrounds are named through node.surface

forbid: any value that is not a catalog surface id
surface.use: node.surface from the closed surface list, further limited to the contract allowedSurfaces (TOKEN_SURFACE_NOT_ALLOWED)

forbid: px / rem / em / vh / vw literals in content
spacing.use: spacing is owned by section contracts; no PageSpec field carries spacing

forbid: the licensed faces (Aeonik Fono, Aeonik Mono)
fontFamily.use: the families in the catalog; typography is owned by section contracts

overrides.gap: The PageSpec schema has no free-form style or token-override field (MASTER-GUIDE 3.21): styling is owned by section and component contracts. The only token references a PageSpec carries are the closed `theme` enum and the closed per-node `surface` enum, both validated against the catalog and the contracts. Adversarial coverage for spacing, font and raw-colour values therefore targets text content (TOKEN_RAW_*) and the catalog/policy files (drift cases in extraction/prove_drift.py), not a nonexistent override field.

conventionOnly: semantic colour roles outside surface.* are documentation for generators; PageSpec content cannot reference them
